create table if not exists pdata_demo_security (
  scr_cd string comment '证券代码',
  scr_cn_full_name string comment '证券中文名称',
  mkt_cd string comment '市场代码',
  list_date string comment '上市日期'
) partitioned by (src_id string)

insert overwrite table pdata_demo_security partition (src_id='A')
select a.security_code as scr_cd,
       a.security_name as scr_cn_full_name,
       a.market_code as mkt_cd,
       a.list_date as list_date
from odata_vendor_a.security_master a

insert overwrite table pdata_demo_security partition (src_id='B')
select b.sec_code as scr_cd,
       b.sec_name as scr_cn_full_name,
       b.market_id as mkt_cd,
       cast(null as string) as list_date
from odata_vendor_b.security_basic b

insert overwrite table dm_demo_security
select coalesce(a.scr_cd, b.scr_cd) as scr_cd,
       case when a.src_id = 'A' then a.scr_cn_full_name else b.scr_cn_full_name end as scr_cn_full_name,
       coalesce(a.mkt_cd, b.mkt_cd) as mkt_cd,
       a.list_date as list_date
from pdata_demo_security a
left join pdata_demo_security b on a.scr_cd = b.scr_cd and a.src_id = 'A' and b.src_id = 'B'

insert overwrite table pdata_demo_security_usage
select t.scr_cd as scr_cd,
       t.scr_cn_full_name as secu_name
from pdata_demo_security t
where t.src_id = 'A'

insert overwrite table pdata_demo_security_snapshot
select s.scr_cd as scr_cd,
       s.mkt_cd as mkt_cd
from pdata_demo_security s
